verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes DJ-style knobs and other decorative control details as part of the machine's rendered physical design.
The client specifies silver buttons and knobs modeled on the rendered DJ-booth styling for the rebuilt base.
The client changes the decorative-button acceptance condition from general DJ-inspired styling to recreation of the rendered buttons.
The source explicitly leaves the silver DJ controls and broader cosmetic redesign pending a client choice between current-prototype implementation and a later V2 milestone.
The client prioritizes the functional prototype and postpones further decorative control and cosmetic work until after delivery.
